Classify New Transactions

Source: R/cba.R
predict.dynarules_cba.Rd

Classify New Transactions

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dynarules_cba'
predict(object, newdata = NULL, type = c("class", "rule"), ...)

Arguments

object

A dynarules_cba classifier.

newdata

Transactions to classify: a dyna_transactions object or anything transactions() accepts. Defaults to the training data.

type

"class" (default) returns the predicted labels; "rule" returns the index of the rule that fired, NA where the default was used.

...

Ignored.

Value

A character vector of predictions, or an integer vector of rule indices.

See also

cba()

Examples

tx <- list(c("hot", "humid", "no"), c("mild", "humid", "yes"),
           c("cool", "windy", "yes"), c("mild", "windy", "no"))
fit <- cba(tx, class = c("yes", "no"), min_support = 0.2,
           min_confidence = 0.5)
predict(fit, tx)
#> [1] "no"  "yes" "yes" "no"
